items.a: ¡Sí! Nuestro personal bilingüe puede ayudarle en español.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, Apple Pay and cash. Business house-accounts may pay on invoice.

items.q: How large a sample do you need to match a paint color?
items.a: A flat sample at least 1 inch square (larger than a quarter) gives the most accurate reading on our Benjamin Moore spectrophotometer.

items.q: Do you carry Benjamin Moore Aura, Regal, Ben & ElementGuard?
items.a: Yes—all in stock. Benjamin Moore Aura goes on promotion regularly; ask at the counter or check the current in-store flyer for the latest offer.

items.q: Do I need an appointment for key cutting?
items.a: No appointment needed. Most house or padlock keys are duplicated in under two minutes.
We stock chip-less automotive blanks and can duplicate older vehicle keys. Transponder and high-security laser keys require referral to a locksmith.

items.q: Will you cut plywood or sheet-rock to size?
items.a: Absolutely—your first two cuts are free on every panel; each additional cut is $1 (as of 2026).

items.q: What sizes of sheet-rock and plywood do you stock?
items.a: ½″ & ⅝″ Sheet-rock (regular & mold-resistant), ½″ and ¾″ plywood, cement board 3 ft × 5 ft, 2 × 4 studs in 8′ and 10′ lengths, plus drop-ceiling tiles 2′ × 4′.
Yes—black iron or galvanized pipe up to 2″ NPT cut and threaded while you wait.

items.q: What areas do you deliver to?
items.a: Yonkers, Bronxville, Mt Vernon, Hastings-on-Hudson and most of southern Westchester. Delivery starts at $15 (as of 2026); heavy or pallet loads are quoted individually.

items.q: Do you sell Yonkers-certified waste bins and Tuff garbage bags?
items.a: Yes. We stock certified curbside bins plus Tuff Bags in 55- and 65-gallon sizes, and compactor bags (34–36″) in 50-count boxes.

items.q: Do you sharpen knives and tools?
items.a: Kitchen knives, scissors, chisels and mower blades can be dropped off weekdays before 2 p.m. for same-day pick-up.
Unopened, non-tinted items may be returned within 30 days with receipt. Custom-tinted paint, cut materials and threaded pipe are final sale.

items.q: Do you offer bulk or contractor pricing?
items.a: Yes—show us a current invoice or quote and we’ll meet or beat comparable pricing on paint, sheet-goods, Quikrete, etc. You can also open a tax-exempt house account with valid resale certificate.
